# IOARTS

> IOARTS is a Swedish digital art fanart and illustration gallery with selected physical and digital products.

## Public pages

- Home: https://www.ioarts.ink/
- Products: https://www.ioarts.ink/products
- Contact: https://www.ioarts.ink/contact
- Privacy policy: https://www.ioarts.ink/privacy-policy
- Terms of sale: https://www.ioarts.ink/terms-of-sale
- Copyright and attribution: https://www.ioarts.ink/copyright-attribution

## Contact

- Email: brevduva999@proton.me
- Address: Loviselundsvägen 27, 16559 Hässelby, Sweden

## Guidance

Product pages under `/products/` are the canonical source for product names, descriptions, images, availability, and prices. The sitemap at `/sitemap.xml` lists public product pages. Checkout, cart, account, and API routes are transactional and should not be treated as informational sources.
